prompts.male: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production PNG sprite atlas for an original Chinese mythology HD-2D action RPG in Godot, not a mockup. Style: polished cute Japanese hand-drawn RPG chibi, 2.8 heads tall, soft watercolor cel shading, clear dark colored outline, intricate but readable full clothing. Orthographic view at slightly elevated game-camera angle, consistent scale. A PERFECT 4 columns x 4 rows uniform grid filling a square canvas. Exactly sixteen isolated full-body poses. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no floor, no shadows, no effects, no weapons. Genuinely transparent background, spacious transparent padding in every cell; feet aligned at 90% of cell height, head at 10%, body horizontally centered. Rows are facing: row1 FRONT facing viewer (south), row2 RIGHT profile facing right (east), row3 BACK facing away (north), row4 LEFT profile facing left (west). Columns are animation: col1 relaxed idle, col2 walking left foot forward, col3 walking right foot forward, col4 unarmed attack/casting lunge with right arm extended. The same character identity, costume, hair, and proportions in all sixteen cells; back views must show hair and costume back, no face. No overlapping cells or clipped feet. Clothing is fully modest and suitable for school audiences. Subject: young adult male Chinese wandering scholar swordsman, expressive dark eyes, deep brown spiky tied ponytail, pale ivory tunic under jade teal short open traveling coat, wide charcoal trousers, leather boots, bronze belt clasp, jade tassel and pale scarf. Hands EMPTY; weapons are separate 3D objects in game. Agile adventurous personality. Four directional views with genuine walking and attack poses, no repetitive copied faces in back rows.

prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production 4 by 4 transparent enemy atlas for a Chinese mythology HD-2D game. Sixteen cells, each isolated on genuine transparent background with no shadow, text, labels, borders or effects. Cute richly painted chibi RPG character artwork with clean dark colored outlines and soft watercolor cel shading, matching polished Japanese HD-2D hand-drawn standees. Each cell uses same centered baseline, full body including feet and tail fit inside cell with 10% padding. Each ROW is ONE creature. COLUMNS are exact orthographic directions FRONT (facing viewer), RIGHT profile, BACK facing away, LEFT profile. Row1: original tiny ink spirit, round dark navy inky body, two brush-tip ears, cute luminous jade eyes and little ink paws. Row2: original flying paper talisman sprite, folded ivory paper body, red square seal and indigo blue ribbons, little ink eyes; back shows folded paper not eyes. Row3: original stocky stone armored forest ape, moss green slate plates, bronze stone gauntlets, amber eyes, sturdy legs, no weapons. Row4: original majestic elegant nine-tailed white fox, ivory fur, gold forehead mark, jade collar, nine distinct graceful fluffy tails curling around the body; all tails fit inside every cell; back view shows nine tails and back of fox head. Each row creature same design across its four views, no names, no borrowed franchise designs.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2 by 2 square material texture atlas for miniature Chinese mythological forest HD-2D 3D scenery. Four equal edge-to-edge square panels, no padding, labels, frames, objects or perspective. Panel top-left: delicate richly layered jade meadow grass with little pale yellow and ivory wildflower details, dark moss between leaves, painterly hand-painted RPG terrain texture. Panel top-right: warm ancient gray-beige irregular Chinese flagstone paving, subtle moss and soft cracks, natural compact stones, painterly stylization. Panel bottom-left: rich emerald forest canopy leaves, varied tiny painted leaves and amber highlights, no trunk or branches. Panel bottom-right: weathered teal jade-green carved temple stone with subtle gold veins, subdued detailed surface without symbols or lettering. Each panel must be a flat orthographic uniform material swatch with low contrast across edges for tiling; baked soft form detail, no cast shadows. High-quality warm watercolor Japanese RPG miniature art direction, original textures. Opaque background.
